transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We are flying blind without data; surge testing and genomic surveillance in affected cities will reveal true spread, severity, and transmissibility so we can calibrate the response.

actions.rationale: We are flying blind without data; surge testing and genomic surveillance in affected cities will reveal true spread, severity, and transmissibility so we can calibrate the response.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: The public needs honest, data-driven communication from the top immediately to build trust and cooperation before fear or misinformation fills the vacuum.

actions.rationale: The public needs honest, data-driven communication from the top immediately to build trust and cooperation before fear or misinformation fills the vacuum.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives the public, governors, and health systems a shared operating picture and reinforces federal leadership.

actions.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives the public, governors, and health systems a shared operating picture and reinforces federal leadership.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: PPE, tests, and ventilators have long lead times; invoking the DPA now ensures supply is ready if cases surge, and the cost of being over-prepared is far lower than being caught short.

actions.rationale: PPE, tests, and ventilators have long lead times; invoking the DPA now ensures supply is ready if cases surge, and the cost of being over-prepared is far lower than being caught short.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions slows the seeding of new outbreaks while we assess severity and transmissibility.

actions.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions slows the seeding of new outbreaks while we assess severity and transmissibility.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We will need emergency funding and statutory authority for testing, supplies, and potential economic relief; engaging Congress now ensures we are not delayed when speed matters most.

actions.rationale: We will need emergency funding and statutory authority for testing, supplies, and potential economic relief; engaging Congress now ensures we are not delayed when speed matters most.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.

transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.3 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 57/100. Hospital strain 5/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutics development has the longest lead time of any intervention; starting a crash program now is cheap insurance against a catastrophic scenario and wasted money in a mild one.

actions.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutics development has the longest lead time of any intervention; starting a crash program now is cheap insurance against a catastrophic scenario and wasted money in a mild one.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: If this virus follows typical respiratory patterns, the elderly and high-risk will bear the brunt; focusing early protection on them is a proportionate, low-cost measure that saves lives without shutting down society.

actions.rationale: If this virus follows typical respiratory patterns, the elderly and high-risk will bear the brunt; focusing early protection on them is a proportionate, low-cost measure that saves lives without shutting down society.

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: Mandating masks in federal jurisdictions and urging a national standard is a low-economic-cost intervention that can slow spread while we gather more data, and it signals seriousness without panic.

actions.rationale: Mandating masks in federal jurisdictions and urging a national standard is a low-economic-cost intervention that can slow spread while we gather more data, and it signals seriousness without panic.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Continuing daily honest briefings maintains public trust at 57% and ensures Americans understand the evolving picture and what is being asked of them.

actions.rationale: Continuing daily honest briefings maintains public trust at 57% and ensures Americans understand the evolving picture and what is being asked of them.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Pre-positioning economic relief — household payments and small business support — ensures we can deploy quickly if the situation worsens, rather than negotiating under crisis pressure later.

actions.rationale: Pre-positioning economic relief — household payments and small business support — ensures we can deploy quickly if the situation worsens, rather than negotiating under crisis pressure later.

transcript.sitrep:
DEVELOPMENT: A cluster at a packed event seeds cases in a dozen new states. Pressure to act -- or to stop overreacting -- is intense from all sides.

SITUATION (Week 3). Estimated infection index 1.7 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 101/100. Public trust 59/100. Hospital strain 6/100. Restriction level 1.0/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 32/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: federal_lockdown_guidance

params.rationale: The infection index is climbing exponentially and spread has reached a dozen new states; acting before deaths and hospital strain confirm severity is the only way to stay ahead of the curve if this turns out to be severe.

actions.rationale: The infection index is climbing exponentially and spread has reached a dozen new states; acting before deaths and hospital strain confirm severity is the only way to stay ahead of the curve if this turns out to be severe.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Moving to federal lockdown guidance requires maximum public trust; honest daily briefings explaining the rationale — that we're acting early precisely because the data is uncertain — are essential for compliance.

actions.rationale: Moving to federal lockdown guidance requires maximum public trust; honest daily briefings explaining the rationale — that we're acting early precisely because the data is uncertain — are essential for compliance.

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: With cases now in many states, we need broader surveillance to identify hotspots and direct resources; testing is our eyes on this virus.

actions.rationale: With cases now in many states, we need broader surveillance to identify hotspots and direct resources; testing is our eyes on this virus.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Lockdown guidance will cause economic hardship; pre-positioned relief payments and small business support must be ready to deploy to sustain public cooperation.

actions.rationale: Lockdown guidance will cause economic hardship; pre-positioned relief payments and small business support must be ready to deploy to sustain public cooperation.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: As restrictions take hold, doubling down on focused protection of nursing homes and high-risk populations is where targeted effort saves the most lives.

actions.rationale: As restrictions take hold, doubling down on focused protection of nursing homes and high-risk populations is where targeted effort saves the most lives.

SITUATION (Week 4). Estimated infection index 2.2 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 101/100. Public trust 61/100. Hospital strain 7/100. Restriction level 2.8/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 58/100.
ASSESSMENT (HIGH confidence): the pathogen is clearly worse than seasonal flu, with meaningful hospitalization; transmissibility is moderate.

actions.name: federal_lockdown_guidance

params.rationale: High-confidence assessment confirms this is worse than flu with rising hospital strain and an infection index still climbing at 2.2; stronger federal guidance is needed to push restriction levels up before the death lag catches up to us.

actions.rationale: High-confidence assessment confirms this is worse than flu with rising hospital strain and an infection index still climbing at 2.2; stronger federal guidance is needed to push restriction levels up before the death lag catches up to us.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Now that we have high-confidence data, sharing it transparently — including the honest admission that early action was precautionary and is now vindicated — will strengthen public trust and compliance with restrictions.

actions.rationale: Now that we have high-confidence data, sharing it transparently — including the honest admission that early action was precautionary and is now vindicated — will strengthen public trust and compliance with restrictions.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: As restrictions tighten and the economy begins to absorb the impact, relief payments and small business support must be deployed now to sustain household stability and public cooperation with the lockdown.

actions.rationale: As restrictions tighten and the economy begins to absorb the impact, relief payments and small business support must be deployed now to sustain household stability and public cooperation with the lockdown.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Hospital strain is rising and confirmed worse-than-flu severity means admissions will accelerate; DPA production of PPE, tests, and ventilators must be ramped to meet coming demand.

actions.rationale: Hospital strain is rising and confirmed worse-than-flu severity means admissions will accelerate; DPA production of PPE, tests, and ventilators must be ramped to meet coming demand.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Vaccine progress at 58/100 is strong but this is now confirmed as a serious pathogen; every week of acceleration on the vaccine timeline saves lives.

actions.rationale: Vaccine progress at 58/100 is strong but this is now confirmed as a serious pathogen; every week of acceleration on the vaccine timeline saves lives.
